text:
Logan Cooley is having the season people expected when Arizona took him third overall in 2022. He has 13 goals and 28 points in 23 games for Utah, 1.22 points a game after 0.80 last season, and he's on a five-game point streak. He's playing almost 19 minutes a night and is on the ice for 77% of Utah's power-play chances, up from 61%. Seventeen of his points have come with the extra man.

The role change is real and so is the speed: his top skating speed sits in the 99th percentile in NHL EDGE tracking. Last season Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him carrying the puck in on 56% of his entries and setting up teammates at an 85th-percentile rate.

The finishing is the part to be careful with. He's shooting 35% on 7.1 expected goals, and in his last ten games he has 16 points where we'd expect about 11. That pace won't hold. Our range for his season still lands between 72 and 99 points, which would be a big step for a 22-year-old. Watch the power-play share. That's what built this.
headline: Cooley's breakout is real, the shooting is not
